prompt: Write a short retirement speech about a coworker named Andrea that's retiring after 24 years of service as a staff member working at Rutgers University.
response: Ladies and gentlemen, we gather here today to celebrate the retirement of Andrea, who has dedicated 24 years of her life to Rutgers University. Andrea has been a staff member, and while her role may seem routine, her impact has been anything but. Her consistent presence and hard work have been the backbone of our operations. As she steps into retirement, we wish her all the best and look forward to her continued contributions, perhaps as a part-time consultant.
